steps.eval: (() => { const sidebar=document.querySelector('[data-slot="sidebar"]'); if(sidebar===null) return 'NO SIDEBAR'; const row=[...sidebar.querySelectorAll('button')].find((button) => /插件|Plugins/u.test((button.innerText??'').trim())); if(row===undefined) return 'NO PLUGIN ROW'; row.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

steps.check: the full-page header gives its opaque theme surface back to the wallpaper
steps.expr: (() => { const bar=document.querySelector('[class*="pageBar"][data-natural]'); if(bar===null) return 'NO PAGE BAR'; const before=getComputedStyle(bar, '::before'); return before.content === 'none' || before.backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' || before.backgroundColor === 'transparent'; })()

steps.check: the plugin page body and the main column stay transparent
steps.expr: (() => { const main=document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]')?.parentElement; if(!main) return 'NO MAIN'; const page=document.querySelector('[class*="page"]'); const pageStyle=page===null?null:getComputedStyle(page); return getComputedStyle(main).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && (pageStyle===null || pageStyle.backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('[data-slot="sidebar"] [role="treeitem"]'); if(row===null) return 'NO SESSION ROW'; row.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

steps.check: returning to a conversation leaves no opaque surface covering the main column
steps.expr: (() => { const main=document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]')?.parentElement; if(!main) return 'NO MAIN'; const rect=main.getBoundingClientRect(); const opaque=[...main.querySelectorAll('*')].filter((element) => { const style=getComputedStyle(element); const box=element.getBoundingClientRect(); return box.width > rect.width * 0.7 && box.height > rect.height * 0.7 && style.backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && style.backgroundColor !== 'transparent'; }); return getComputedStyle(main).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && opaque.length === 0; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const anchor=document.querySelector('[data-slot="main.conversation"]') ?? document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]'); if(anchor===null) return 'NO ANCHOR'; let element=anchor; while(element.parentElement!==null && element.parentElement.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-main')===false) element=element.parentElement; element.classList.add('dshcb-e2e-opaque'); element.style.backgroundColor='rgb(21, 21, 23)'; window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); return element.className; })()

steps.check: a rebuilt opaque conversation surface is measured and cleared again
steps.expr: (() => { const element=document.querySelector('.dshcb-e2e-opaque'); if(element===null) return 'NO ELEMENT'; return getComputedStyle(element).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; })()
